source: results/15_quality_issues.csv (sql/15_site_support.sql, Q4); decisions detailed in docs/data_quality_notes.md

issues.issue: Second delivered orders placed on the same calendar day as the first
issues.decision: A repeat customer is one who returned on a later calendar day

issues.issue: customer_id is created per order; one person can have several
Orders purchased outside the analysis window (thin months at both ends)
Orders with more than one review
issues.decision: Keep the latest review per order

issues.issue: review_id values that appear on more than one order
issues.decision: Never join on review_id; key reviews by (review_id, order_id)

issues.issue: Delivered in-window orders where items + freight differ from total paid by more than 0.01
issues.decision: Revenue uses item prices; mismatches left unexplained and listed as a limitation

issues.issue: Orders with status delivered but no customer delivery date
Orders with status canceled that have a customer delivery date
issues.decision: Kept as canceled; not used for delivery timing

issues.issue: Products whose category has no English translation
issues.decision: Fall back to the Portuguese name

issues.issue: Source columns spelled lenght instead of length
issues.decision: Raw table unchanged; v_products exposes corrected names

issues.issue: Timed in-window orders with a negative stage duration
issues.decision: Excluded from stage statistics only; reported as a limitation

issues.issue: Geolocation rows that exactly duplicate another row
issues.decision: v_geo averages distinct points, one row per zip prefix

issues.issue: Customer zip prefixes with no geolocation row
issues.decision: Orders without coordinates left out of distance analysis

issues.issue: Orders with no order_items rows (all statuses, all dates)
issues.decision: Drop out of item-level analysis naturally; kept in status counts
